subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort

756740101.text: Something like this... and like that... Those little thieves will be on their knees crying for mercy...

756740102.text: At a moment like this, if you "accidentally" let one of them slip away, He'll panic and run back to report it — and you just quietly tail him...

756740103.text: Then, right when they're busy planning their next move, you kick down the door to their hideout and give them the scare of a lifetime!

756740104.text: You make a very good point, Ms. Enghiene. When dealing with irredeemable criminals, unconventional methods are indeed necessary.

756740105.text: Natlan isn't like Fontaine, with all those convoluted... ahem, "elaborate law enforcement procedures"! I'll make good use of that advantage.

756740106.text: I already rounded up the remaining Saurian poachers earlier. I'll use your method and wipe out the smugglers to the north in one fell swoop.

756740107.text: And don't forget to give me the good news afterward. I'm really looking forward to it!

756740108.text: *sigh*... I'm no longer a member of the Maison Gardiennage. Under confidentiality regulations, Turenna can no longer report her work to me either.

756740109.text: Feels like I still have a few tricks I haven't shared with the people who could use them... Maybe I should just write a memoir?

756740110.text: Yes, a memoir sold exclusively to law enforcement all over the world! My 150 years of experience should be useful.

756740111.text: I'm all for it! Once you've fully enjoyed this party and feel nice and refreshed, writing it is sure to go smoothly too...

756740112.text: Then save me a signed copy!

756740113.text: You'll get the very first one! Once I've danced to my heart's content, I'll rent a typewriter as soon as I get back and start writing immediately!

756740115.text: Now that's an unexpected combination. What are they talking about?

756740118.text: Alright! Our lead dancer is here — the great Tumaini! Let the party begin!

756740119.text: First things first — big news! Our second dance party is now underway!

756740120.text: And we've got new participants too: Ms. Enghiene from the Fontaine tour group, along with her three companions!

756740121.text: Also, thanks to our "Uthabiti," Kachina, and the idol from Mondstadt, the Fontaine guests and the Ashas here have all learned brand-new dance moves!

756740122.text: Wait, wait, wait... that's way too much information at once...

756740123.text: So besides everyone from before and the little Saurians, there are Melusines and... Ashas joining the stage too?

756740124.text: Exactly! Which means we get to dance to even more upbeat music and have even more fun!

756740125.text: As the lead dancer, you'll also get to show how well you can adapt to any rhythm!

756749901.text: Natlan's couriers have left us a message at the Adventurers' Guild. It says that the People of the Springs, Children of Echoes, and the Flower-Feather Clan are organizing a party at Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

756749902.text: That sounds kinda familiar... Seems like it should be super fun! Let's look into it when we have time!
